editorial:
Imagine walking through the dirty streets of old London and finding someone who looks like a monster but has the heart of a saint. You will follow a doctor who discovers a man kept in a cage and treated like a freak show attraction. Instead of being scared, the doctor decides to help him find a better life. It feels less like a big movie and more like you are sitting in a theater watching a live play, which makes the bond between the two men feel very real and personal. 

What really grabs you is the acting; you can tell the emotions are raw because there are no fancy camera tricks to hide behind. The story moves at a steady pace, though some might find it a bit slow since it is mostly talking. If you enjoy stories about kindness and overcoming hate, you need to see this. Since it is a recorded play, you can easily find it for rent on Apple TV or stream it on Prime Video. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this touching story forever.
endingExplained: At the end, the man realizes he can only feel safe if he sleeps lying flat on his back. He asks the doctor for a special pillow to help him do this. Sadly, when he tries to sleep this way, he suffocates and dies in his sleep. It is a sad ending, but it shows that he finally found peace and dignity in his final moments, surrounded by people who actually loved him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional stories about human kindness.
